'''''Daiman's Rise''''' was a [[Marble/Legends|marble]] statue of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]]. The statue was sited in Xakrea's central plaza and faced in the direction of the avenue [[Celestial Way]].
